title: WHO I AM | Strong Mind, Balance & Bold Moves – Guided Meditation Podcast by Jacky
author: Jacqueline Friebe
description: While your outer world is buzzing and you are in the middle of smashing business, family, social life, carework, projects, always trying to self improve and finding ways to grow beyond yourself, at times, all you need is me-time. Body and mind are craving for balance. Allow me to guide you towards a Strong Mindset that will initiate Bold Moves led by intuition and authenticity. If growing healthy and strong is your goal, finding your inner Safe Space through intense self connection is just the beginning to a new life full of power, purpose, joy and success.
